label: M3 S13 | The 30 Essential Keyboard Shortcuts & Audit Tools

trace_tools.dependents: Draws blue arrows FROM the selected cell TO all cells that depend on it. Click WACC, press Alt+M,D, see every cell that changes when WACC changes.
trace_tools.precedents: Draws blue arrows FROM the cells that feed INTO the selected cell. Click target price, press Alt+M,P, instantly see contributing cells. Press again for next level.
trace_tools.cross_sheet: When a precedent/dependent is on a different sheet, Excel draws a dashed arrow to a small sheet icon. Double-click the arrow to see external references.

before.f4_importance: F4 is the single most important shortcut in financial modelling. When editing a formula, it cycles through reference types: A1 → $A$1 → A$1 → $A1. Saves more time than any other shortcut. Every time you would type a $ sign manually, press F4 instead.

go_to_special.description: The most powerful selection tool in Excel. Selects cells by TYPE.

evaluate_formula.method: Enter edit mode (F2), select ONE part of the formula, press F9. Excel replaces that portion with its actual value.
evaluate_formula.critical_warning: If you press Enter instead of Escape after using F9, Excel PERMANENTLY replaces the formula portion with the static value. Always press Escape.
